comparison_methods.state: Exact serialized cache bytes, including positions; hidden values compare exactly after conversion to F32, without a tolerance.

limitations: A final-budget draft has zero chance of acceptance by contract; this change does not alter acceptance math for remaining budgets above1.

Exact state, failure recovery and next-step controls do not establish the official trained-head mathematics. The pinned official reference omits that head and MTPLX labels its candidate reconstructed.

One32-token request, one4-bit pack and six measured pairs per binary are bounded cost evidence. Runs before and after are separate process campaigns; filesystem cache and host conditions are uncontrolled between them.

The final-budget draft/cache interval decreases from a median3085us to1008.5us. Whole-request paired MTP/direct decode ratios are1.01287 before and1.04244 after; both modes also slow across campaigns. No end-to-end acceleration or causal attribution of that drift is established.
Direct controls retain attached-head memory, clear both prefix stores before every request and do not measure head-loading cost. No MLX-LM performance baseline is supplied.
Public paired samples retain timing, IDs, memory counters and selected prefill/final-step route fields; full per-step route traces remain in the hashed private raw results.

Two initial regression harness mistakes concerned cache serialization layer counts. Failed and cancelled logs remain private; final old-code failures specifically identify discarded draft logits, and corrected F32/BF16 and real controls pass.
No default promotion, full-checkpoint numerical agreement, broad-quality acceptance, profitable MTP or unavailable M5 Ultra qualification follows.
